camel_example:
aliyun resourcecenter GetMultiAccountResourceCounts --region cn-hangzhou --Filter.1.MatchType Equals --Scope 'rd-r4****
' --GroupByKey ResourceType --Filter.1.Value.1 'cn-shanghai' --Filter.1.Key RegionId
description_en: Queries the resource count in the management account and multiple member accounts of a resource folder
description_zh: 查询资源目录管理账号和多个成员中的资源数量
name: GetMultiAccountResourceCounts

parameters.help_en:
The grouping dimension for resource count statistics. Valid values:
ResourceType: resource type
RegionId: region
ResourceGroupId: resource group ID

If this parameter is not specified, the total number of resources that meet the conditions is returned
parameters.help_zh:
资源数量统计的分组维度。取值：
ResourceType：资源类型。
RegionId：地域。
ResourceGroupId：资源组ID。

如果不传，则返回满足条件的资源总数
parameters.name: group_by_key

fields.help_en: The key of the filter condition. For valid values, see `Supported filter parameters` below
fields.help_zh: 过滤条件键。取值见下方`支持的过滤参数`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The match type. Valid value: Equals, which indicates an exact match
fields.help_zh:
匹配方式。

取值为Equals，表示相等匹配
fields.name: match_type

fields.help_en: The value of the filter condition
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The account scope for the search. Valid values: 
Resource directory ID: searches for resources in the management account and all member accounts.
Root folder ID: searches for resources in all member accounts under the Root folder and its subfolders.
Folder ID: searches for resources in all member accounts under the specified folder.
Member account ID: searches for resources in the specified member account.

For more information about how to obtain the resource directory ID, Root folder ID, folder ID, and member account ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/159995.html, https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/159997.html, and https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/160016.html
parameters.help_zh:
搜索的账号范围。取值： 
资源目录ID：表示搜索管理账号和所有成员中的资源。
Root资源夹ID：表示搜索Root资源夹及子资源夹下的所有成员中的资源。
资源夹ID：表示搜索指定资源夹下所有成员中的资源。
成员ID：表示搜索指定成员中的资源。

关于如何获取资源目录ID、Root资源夹ID、资源夹ID和成员ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/159995.html、https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/159997.html、https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/160016.html
